name: NPR-Riken Corporation
summary: NPR-Riken Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automobile engine parts, marine engine parts, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts Business, Piping and Construction Equipment Business, Thermal Engineering Business, and Other segments.
